# Stallion Developments

> Ontario home builder and developer, Tarion-registered and engineer-led. Building new homes in Bracebridge (Muskoka), Kitchener and Prince Edward County.

## Communities
- [Maple Place, Bracebridge](https://www.stalliondevelopments.com/communities/maple-place/): 4 semi-detached homes, 3 bed / 2.5 bath, ~1,900 sq ft plus a finished, rentable lower level with separate entrance. From $900,000 + HST. Occupancy summer 2027. Now selling.
- [Anglo Street, Bracebridge](https://www.stalliondevelopments.com/communities/anglo-street/): semi-detached homes on a 1-acre site. Delivering Q4 2028.
- [Chicopee Heights, Kitchener](https://www.stalliondevelopments.com/communities/chicopee-heights/): 6+ detached homes on 3 acres near Chicopee Ski & Summer Resort. Delivering Q4 2028.
- [Lady of the Woods, Prince Edward County](https://www.stalliondevelopments.com/communities/lady-of-the-woods/): 22 estate homes on 1-acre lots near Picton. Coming 2029.

- [Blog](https://www.stalliondevelopments.com/blog/): building updates from Stallion's communities and advice for buying a new home in Ontario.
